arabic text: Zehr se tukre jigar, khoon say kafan laal huwa Wa Hassan-e-\nsabz-e-qaba
english translation text: Poison tore his liver into pieces, and blood\nturned his shroud red—alas, Hasan of the green cloak.

arabic text:
Khun ugalte huwe bhayi ko behan ne dekha
or tarap ker ye kaha
Teri gurbat pe ay bhayi teri Zainab ho fidaa wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-
e-Qaba
english translation text:
The sister saw her brother coughing blood
and cried out in anguish: O brother,
may your Zainab be sacrificed for
your loneliness—alas, Hasan of the green cloak.

arabic text:
Maa ke dukh se abhi azad kahan thi zainab
hogaya kaisa gazab
Baap zinda na raha Bhayi suwe khuld gaya wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-
e-Qaba
english translation text:
Zainab had not yet been freed from her
mother's grief when this new calamity descended. Her
father was no more, and her brother departed
towards Paradise—alas, Hasan of the green cloak.

arabic text:
Ker diya Zahr-e-hala hal ne Jigar ke tukre
Aur Qasim ke liye
Kamsini me hai ye gham Sham-e-gharibi jaisa wa Hassan -e-
Sabaz-e-Qaba
english translation text:
The deadly poison tore his liver
apart; and for young Qasim, this
grief became like the night of
loneliness—alas, Hasan of the green cloak.

arabic text:
Ghar se ik baar janaza jo nikal jata hai
kab wo phir aata hain
Aisa taboot hai ye lot ke jo ghar ayaa wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-
Qaba
english translation text:
Once a funeral leaves the home,
when does it ever return? Yet this
was such a bier that returned
back home—alas, Hasan of the green cloak.

arabic text:
Sheh ne us wakht jo Ghazi ko na roka hota
hashr ho jata bapaa
teer aate na janaze pe tumhare Maula wa Hassan -e-Sabaz-e-
Qaba
Sheh ko Rehan baraadar kaa jigar yaad aya
jab sare karbobala
Tukde Qassim ke utha te huwe maula ne kaha wa Hassan -e-
Sabaz-e-Qaba
english translation text:
Had the King not restrained Ghazi at
that moment, Judgement Day would have arisen;
then arrows would not have struck
your funeral, O Maula—alas, Hasan of the
green cloak. O Rehan, the King
remembered his brother's liver when, in Karbala,
he lifted Qasim's scattered pieces and
cried: alas, Hasan of the green cloak.
